title: Validate Sudoku Board
description:
Write a function `is_valid_sudoku(board)` that checks if a 9×9 Sudoku board is valid.

A valid board has:
- Each row containing digits 1-9 without repetition
- Each column containing digits 1-9 without repetition
- Each of the nine 3×3 sub-boxes containing digits 1-9 without repetition

Empty cells are represented as `0`. The board need not be solvable or complete — just check no duplicates in rows, columns, or boxes.
hint: Use sets to track seen numbers in each row, column, and 3×3 box. Check all three simultaneously in nested loops.
outputExplanation: The algorithm iterates through each row, column, and box using sets to detect duplicates.
